meta.source: Pixel-faithful clone of https://www.arrakis.tech/ — React 18 + Vite 5 + Tailwind v3 + framer-motion. Structure derived from src/App.jsx (routes), src/pages/*.jsx and src/components/IndustryPage.jsx (section order), cross-checked against the five Playwright-measured CLONE_SPEC*.md files.
notes: Section order per template was read from the real JSX render order, not inferred from the specs.
'chrome' is uniform ('full') on every template — the persistent Header/Footer/CookieNotice come from src/components/Layout.jsx. The axis that actually varies is 'headerTheme'.
template.not-found has routeCount 0 deliberately: it is the react-router '*' catch-all and matches no enumerable site path, so it is excluded from totalRoutes.

categories.SHELL: Persistent chrome rendered by Layout.jsx on every route, outside the page body.
categories.MASTHEAD: The top-of-page introduction block that opens a template.
categories.NARRATIVE: Long-form, scroll-driven storytelling blocks — including the two scroll-pinned sections.
categories.PROOF: Third-party or quantitative validation: press, partner logos, metrics, people.
categories.FEATURE: Product capability explainers — accordions, panel stacks, icon grids, callouts.
categories.CONVERSION: Surfaces whose purpose is to get the reader to act or apply.
categories.LEGAL: Long-form policy prose with no marketing furniture.

shell.header.description: Sticky header: wordmark, four nav items (two of which open hover-triggered mega-menu panels), a mailto CTA, and a burger that opens the mobile drawer below lg. Has three measured states — default, scrolled (scrollY>300, collapses 86->64px) and menu-open (inverts to white at unchanged height).

shell.footer.description: Dark footer: CTA card over a background image, three link columns, a centre mark, and a bottom bar with copyright and a LinkedIn link. Carries a mask+blend 'light leak' box that paints nothing on the original either.

shell.cookie-notice.description: Dismissible bottom-right cookie notice, persisted to localStorage. Deliberately has no shadow — the original references a shadow-layer class that is undefined in its shipped CSS.
shell.cookie-notice.scope: Mounted by Layout.jsx on all 12 routes. Note: the original was observed not rendering it on the two legal routes in a fresh context — unresolved, may be dismissal state rather than a render rule.

masthead.home-two-column.description: Homepage hero: two-column masthead with an h1, body copy and CTA on the left, and on the right a frame cycling five industry videos on an 8000ms rotation with a progress bar, status pill and live stat. Below it a logo banner cycles seven logos through five slots.

masthead.industry-nav.description: Industry masthead: an industry switcher dropdown, a two-run headline, a solid CTA, and a hero visual that is a Rive canvas on shipping and a static SVG on the other five.

masthead.platform-stacked.description: Platform masthead: headline, a 282-character scroll-linked letter reveal across three paragraphs, a flare image with screen blend, and an eagerly-mounted Rive canvas.

narrative.orbit-showcase.description: Orbit section: two arc SVGs with gradient-stroked rings and end dots, two Rive canvases, a blurred glow ellipse, and a 190-character scroll-linked letter reveal that is linear in scroll and spring-smoothed.
narrative.orbit-showcase.scope: The home route only; carries the #orbitshowcase anchor.

narrative.text-card-dashboard.description: Centred text card above a large Rive dashboard canvas with a bottom fade, on a white-to-dust gradient.

narrative.feature-asset-swap.description: Scroll-pinned feature swap: a 400vh track with a sticky three-column stage, five bracketed feature items whose active state drives a central Rive canvas. Pins at 768px and up; below that it becomes a draggable label rail with a crossfading description and asset.

narrative.statement-showcase.description: Scroll-pinned statement showcase: a fixed 2775px track at every viewport, with spring-smoothed title translation across four plateaus, a 32-line tick ruler that does not exist in the DOM below 960px, and inactive copy held at 0.1 opacity.

narrative.numbered-list.description: Numbered list of principles, each a heading plus body copy with a monospace index.

narrative.sticky-aside-list.description: Two-column list with a sticky left aside heading offset by calc(var(--header-height) + 2.5rem) and a scrolling right-hand item list.

proof.press-banner.description: 'As covered by' banner: a centred heading above a single static row of four press logos, each an external link at 0.6 opacity rising to 1 on hover.

proof.stats-grid.description: Stats block: a heading column beside a two-column grid of six bracketed metric cards driven by number-flow counters, plus a decorative 2x11 bar matrix hidden below md.

proof.logo-showcase.description: Partner logo showcase: a heading, a four-tab category grid, and a vertical Embla marquee stepping 248px every 3000ms with a scaled centre tile.

proof.employee-grid.description: Renders a centred h2 and nothing else — the CMS block carries no employees field, so there is deliberately no grid. Kept as a distinct section because the original emits the block. Do not build a team grid here.

feature.integrations-panels.description: Paginated integration panels: a heading, a stat, a two-column feature list, and a panel card holding a vertical Swiper logo marquee with top and bottom fades, switchable across four category tabs.
feature.integrations-panels.scope: The home route only; carries the #integrations anchor.

feature.icon-slider.description: Horizontal Embla card slider with a 6000ms autoplay, an odometer-style counter, and a pager that renders five dots while only three snaps are reachable at desktop width.

feature.accordion-industry.description: Four-step delivery accordion on a twilight-to-dawn two-layer background, auto-advancing every 8000ms with a linear translateX progress bar, a lazily-mounted Rive canvas, and panel height animating over 300ms while opacity snaps at height-end.

feature.accordion-security.description: Security's own four-item accordion. Shares the industry accordion's 8000ms mechanics but uses a static image rather than Rive, emits no ellipse decoration, and sits on a black-to-twilight-white gradient whose stops interpolate in sRGB rather than oklab.

feature.detail-cards.description: Three feature detail cards on a near-white card background. The third item's subheading is a single space in the CMS, so it emits an empty h6 of zero height that still contributes its 24px margin — the card sits 24px lower by design.
feature.detail-cards.scope: The shipping route only; hideSection is true on the other five industry routes.

feature.text-card-asset.description: A centred text card fused with a wide asset block beneath it, on a dust-to-white gradient.
feature.text-card-asset.scope: The shipping route only — this slot does not exist in the other five industry routes' section arrays.

feature.text-card-security.description: Security's text card. Its body renders the original's invalid markup faithfully — two unclosed h3 elements inside a p — which produces a deliberate React validateDOMNesting warning in development.

feature.stacked-panels.description: Four stacked capability panels with a sticky scroll-spy nav whose active item is hysteretic — a different panel activates scrolling up than scrolling down. The whole section inverts black-to-white via a class swap over 1300ms once its scroll progress passes 0.55. Each panel lazily mounts its own Rive canvas.
feature.stacked-panels.scope: The platform route only; carries the #build anchor.

feature.callout-shield.description: Feature callout: a three-row table of security claims beside a shield PNG that rotates on rotateY from -45deg to 0 as it scrolls, over a pure-CSS blurred ellipse decoration.
feature.callout-shield.scope: The platform route only; carries the #security anchor.

feature.icon-grid.description: Four bracketed cells, each an icon above a short label. Has a light variant (optional heading, dust background) and a dark variant (heading present, black background). The two variants use eight distinct icon files with baked-in colours, not four recoloured ones.
feature.icon-grid.scope: The security and about routes — the only section shared between those two templates.

conversion.career-listings.description: Careers conversion block: a heading, a mailto CTA, and an inline orbital SVG whose six parts reveal in a timed one-shot sequence on intersection, completing in about 1.65s.

legal.policy-body.description: Long-form policy body on black: an h1, a 'Last updated' line, and a sequence of heading-plus-prose blocks. Deliberately carries no prose styling system — paragraphs have zero margin and lists have no bullets or indentation, so list items are visually indistinguishable from paragraphs. All vertical rhythm comes from two flex row-gaps. Terms of Service carries 24 blocks; the Cookie Policy carries 8.
legal.policy-body.scope: Both legal routes, each with its own block array.

utility.not-found-body.description: Catch-all 404 body. Minimal: a heading and a line of copy. The original's own /industries and /careers paths 404, and those routes are deliberately not recreated in the clone.
utility.not-found-body.scope: The react-router '*' catch-all; matches no enumerable site path.
